_comment: Mob templates. pawn_class: SGONPCPawn (creatures/NPCs) or SGOPCPawn (player-like). race: races_classes.RACES id. gear: m_AttachmentGroups entries [mesh type, mesh number, inventory slot] (docs/GEAR.md). damage: [min, max] per hit. loot: a table in loot.json. level -> m_GameplayLevel; title -> m_PlayerDisplayTitle (optional). Placeholder data until the content editor exists (docs/CONTENT_EDITOR.md). merchant: a merchants.json list id (makes the NPC a vendor that can't be attacked). Creatures: race = creature race id (docs/CREATURES.md, e.g. 119 wolf, 69 bear, 104 giant spider), model = variant number (m_iModelNum), gender 1 for female-only races; no gear. aggro_radius: attacks players that come this close (0 = only when attacked). harvest: makes a resource node (EntityTypes 0x800): {kind: mining/lumberjacking/..., item: items.json name, quantity: [min, max], tool: tool type name for /con and errors, skill: required skill, difficulty: skill level the node is 'just right' for}. station: true makes a refining crafting station (EntityTypes 0x4); "finishing" makes a finishing station (offers the kind: finishing recipes, 0x304). parley: a diplomacy.json parley key; lets players parley with the NPC. trainer: true makes an ability trainer (teaches the player's class abilities). banker: true gives bank access. repair: true lets the NPC repair gear. prop: true makes scenery (a static-mesh race, can't be attacked; docs/CRAFTING.md lists working prop races). scale: model DrawScale (some prop meshes are building-sized). abilities: special attacks after a melee swing [{name, kind: dot, chance, damage [min,max], ticks, interval, icon}, or kind stun/root with duration (seconds): the player can't move (stun: nor act)] (harmful effect on the player). faction: a factions.json id (m_FactionId; killing the mob lowers the player's standing). task_master: true makes a crafting task master (EntityTypes 0x200; work orders in workorders.json). mailbox: true makes a mailbox (EntityTypes 0x20000; race 527 is the Thestran mailbox mesh). recipe_trainer: [recipes.json keys] makes a recipe trainer (EntityTypes 0x80) that sells those recipes (their trainer_cost). broker: a market name makes the NPC a broker (player market; docs/MARKET.md). altar: true makes an altar (EntityTypes 0x1000000|0x10): using it binds the player there and lists their tombstone to summon (race 586 is the Bindstone mesh). riftway: a riftways.json key (or "") makes a riftway stone: players standing near one can travel with the map's Riftway tab (/rift). assembly_trainer: [assembly.json keys] sold by the NPC; assembly_station: true makes an assembly station (EntityTypes 0x800000). coin: [min, max] copper on the corpse (default 2-6 per level). spells: [{name, cast (seconds), damage [min, max], chance (after a swing), icon}] the NPC casts at the player it fights; players can counter them (counters.json).
